objective: Turn autonomous intelligence architecture into evidence-driven autonomous behavior while preserving truth, rights, exploration, reversibility, validation and Production boundaries.
milestone_requirements: New rights-admitted empirical evidence materially changes at least one eligible factor or weighted UNKNOWN debt item
Evidence-demand ranking binds decision-impact and business-relevance rationale without overriding truth gates
Exploration/exploitation policy does not increase concentration beyond ceiling without proportional decision-value gain
Factor recomputation and source-removal sensitivity PASS
SHADOW priority/quota/analytical-weight proposal differs deterministically from prior proposal for evidence-backed reasons
Max-delta, rights, freshness, confidence, rollback and circuit-breaker gates PASS
No spend or provider activation without explicit approval
No synthetic/control evidence is promoted to empirical PASS
activation_rule: No SHADOW quota or analytical-weight proposal may be computed from incomplete required empirical factors; no live mutation follows from SHADOW computation without separate activation gates.

primary_kpi.definition: The bounded category x geography surface for which KIDULTS can produce defensible intelligence from rights-admitted, fresh, provenance-bound evidence with required confidence and source-independence controls.

cross_market_intelligence.start_condition: Only after multiple category and geography surfaces have sufficient rights-admitted empirical market evidence, compatible methodology and source-independence. No new standalone engine is justified before that condition.
